description:
PURPOSE: Cancels the verified customer's existing booking. Irreversible.
WHEN TO USE: Only after the customer explicitly confirmed they want to cancel this specific booking (reference and date read back to them).
WHEN NOT TO USE: Not to change the date (use reschedule_booking), never on an unclear request.
REQUIRED: booking_reference, customer_grant (or a signed-in customer). reason and idempotency_key optional.
SIDE EFFECTS: cancels the booking and notifies the customer by SMS/e-mail. Repeating the same call returns the same result.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same value when retrying the same request. If omitted, the server derives the key from the request, so a retry never creates a second booking.

reason.description: Optional short reason given by the customer

session_id.description: Optional. session_id from the previous result, if you have it. The server also recovers the session from quote_id / slot_id / confirmation_id / customer_grant.

name: cancel_booking

booking_id.description: Booking reference to give the customer (same as booking_reference)

error.description: Stable machine-readable error id when success=false, e.g. missing_required_fields, unsupported_postcode, no_availability

success.description: true = operation done / data returned; false = see error

title: Anuluj rezerwację
